 For the Petitioners :- Mr. Sunil Singh, Advocate
 For the State :- Ms Sushma Aind, Advocate

2/16.05.2024

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners as well as the learned
 counsel for the State.

2. The petitioners are apprehending their arrest in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No.07 of 2024,
for the offence registered under sections 376, 313, 323, 504 and 506 of the Ipc, pending in the court
of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj.
3.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that petitioner no.1 is sister in law of Sukesh Oraon against whom the allegations are made of establishing relationship and petitioner no.2 is father of Sukesh Oraon.
He submits that the allegations are there against Sukesh Oraon.
4. Learned State counsel opposed the prayer on the ground that allegations are there against the petitioners also.

5. Looking to the contents of the FIR it transpires that the informant has come into relationship with one Sukesh Oraon and there is no allegation so far these petitioner nos.1 and 2 are concerned of helping Sukesh Kumar for establishing any relationship and it was pointed out that the petitioner no.1 is sister in law and petitioner no.2 is father of Sukesh Oraon, and in the attending facts and Lila Kumari @ Lila Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand ....

circumstances, I am inclined to provide privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

6. Accordingly, both the petitioners, above named, are hereby directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today, and in the event of their surrender/arrest, both the petitioners, above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau at Daltonganj, in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No.07 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
